payload.friendly_name: Pack schemas and pack-level policy in the domain
payload.purpose_context: Pack authors and the charter service need one published, canonical schema per pack file kind, imported from core's models and owned here (ADR-0015, ADR-0017), so that pack verdicts start in parity with core on the real open-packs content. At the same time the pack-level policy (missing and mismatched pack_level) moves out of the YAML adapter into the domain (#48), and the rules a schema cannot express live in the domain as collected findings, ready for the pack doctor parity work (#115).
payload.purpose_tldr: Validate every Charter Pack file against schemas this repository owns, and let the domain alone decide pack-level outcomes.

payload.wp_title: Canonical pack schemas imported with provenance
Domain finding model and the pack-level policy (#48)
Architecture docs, glossary and the write-model diagram
Validate mode and non-vacuous open-packs acceptance
Divergence register and the ADR-0017 amendment
Adapter load path on the schemas, and the contract changes scenarios-first
Open-packs layout catch-up, pin and re-vendor
